name: 75402 · Greenville, TX
findings: ZIP 75402 (Greenville) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75402 (Greenville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75402 (Greenville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
